segments.oily: Reviewers with oily or acne-prone skin report the oil melts sebum and makeup without worsening breakouts, though one reviewer with oily, acne-prone skin developed small hormonal-looking bumps and stopped use.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin say it leaves their face hydrated and softer rather than stripped, including one in a dry climate who found it kept skin calm.
segments.combination: Reviewers with combination skin describe it as cleansing thoroughly while still leaving skin feeling hydrated and balanced.
segments.sensitive: Reviewers with sensitive or reactive skin report no stinging, irritation or breakouts, with one exception noting minor eye irritation.
segments.normal: A reviewer with normal skin describes her face as clean and slightly more moisturized without feeling oily afterward.
segments.mature: Reviewers in their 50s-70s with mature or sun-weathered skin say it lifts makeup well and is part of a routine they credit with visibly improved skin.

concerns.aging: Mature reviewers (50s-70s) report good makeup removal and satisfaction with skin appearance in their routine, though none describe a specific anti-aging effect from this product itself.
concerns.dehydration: Most reviewers describe the product as hydrating or non-drying, leaving skin soft and moisturized; no reviewer reports dryness from it.
concerns.redness: One sensitive-skin reviewer noted minor irritation when the product got into her eyes, but no other redness or reactivity is reported.
concerns.barrier: Reviewers do not describe barrier damage; several say the oil respects skin's moisture and does not strip it.
concerns.spots: One reviewer reports her cystic acne cleared with continued use; another with oily, acne-prone skin developed tiny white bumps and larger pimples on her chin and forehead that resolved after stopping the product.
concerns.blemishes: Several acne-prone reviewers say the product does not cause breakouts and even helped clear skin, but one reviewer explicitly attributes a breakout episode to this product after ruling out other causes.
concerns.oiliness: Oily-skin reviewers say the product removes sebum and grime effectively and does not leave a greasy after-feel, though it initially feels odd applying oil to oily skin.

aspects.libelle: Pump dispenses too much product or leaks

extraits.texte: I started using this product almost 2 months ago. I LOVED how it removed my makeup and just how my skin felt, but pretty quickly i started noticing bumps all over my chin. Like little white pimples but they were so tiny. I thought that was odd but didnt contribute it to this product. I aboslutely looved how my skin felt, then i noticed breakouts. It was so weird its like i would get a big ball type pimple. My mom even asked me what was going on with my skin as ive never had pimples like this before. I didnt know what causing me to breakout as i hadnt changed anything, in fact i added more skincare products. One day my husband said, what if its the new stuff u got? So i stopped using it for 3 days and immediately the white almost "oil" bumps were gone! I am back to repairing the damage this has cause my chin and forehead area. Im so sad because i LOVED this product.

extraits.titre: An sturdy first cleanse in a basic pump
extraits.texte: Dermalogica fan here. For context, I have oily, acne-prone skin with a healthy dose of hormonal acne at the moment. This cleansing oil is a good first cleanse and there are two things that keep this from being an excellent product for me. 1) The pump just squirts a bunch of product out so one must be ready to receive it. You also can't really moderate how much oil you're pumping out. I would describe the pump as efficient but not elegant. 2) The oil isn't the best at melting the waterproof makeup. I use the loreal lash paradise (waterproof) which this oil gets mostly but not all off. I also use the eyeko beach waterproof mascara which is a VERY waterproof mascara. This oil struggles to get maybe half of that mascara off. I would buy this at a heavy sale price but since there are so many cleansing oils to compete with, I wouldn't purchase this at full price when I'll need another product to get my waterproof mascara off. It does not aggravate my skin or make me breakout. I'll still be finishing the one I purchased. I recommend this for someone who does not use waterproof mascara and does not care for an elegant pumping experience

extraits.titre: My skin has never been softer
extraits.texte: I have super oily acne prone skin and after the first use my skin was soooo soft. After a few weeks of using this my skin is smooth, clear, and so glowy! 10/10 product!!!!

extraits.titre: Worth the Price for Clean, Hydrated Skin
extraits.texte: Not only is this my go-to face cleanser each morning and evening, it also does an excellent job of removing my makeup after a dance show. Despite its strength, it leaves my combination skin feeling clean yet still hydrated. It's a bit pricey, but I find it worth every penny—plus, buying the larger size offers the best value. Recommended by my dermatologist, it's been a reliable staple in my routine for years. Though, keep it out of your eyes as I've had some minor irritation!

Works as described. I use it every day and I have sensitive skin. Was worried I'd break out to it but I actually cleared up and my skin got smoother. Of course I used the daily exfoliant along with it great combo!

extraits.titre: Smells so good and cleanses gently
extraits.texte: I would get facials and they would use this precleanser. I loved the smell so much I bought some of my own and it's been one of my favorite cleansers to both remove light makeup and pamper myself. I have combination and sensitive skin and its kept it calm and balanced (especially living in such a dry climate).
The product is nice, skin has never been better. No more cystic acne. Would recommend it to everyone
